checked_contract.raw_measurability: Each of the rectangle, two strip-side disk segments, and two exterior disk caps is closed; their finite union and arbitrary horizontal-translation image are closed and Borel measurable.
checked_contract.null_measurable_fubini: For null-measurable E and F, almost-everywhere equality of almost every horizontal section implies E = F almost everywhere in planar volume. The proof passes through measurable representatives, transports null equality through coordinate swap, and uses both Fubini orders.
checked_contract.sectionwise_interface: HasTypeIVHorizontalSections states one-dimensional almost-everywhere slice agreement and does not contain a planar equality or congruence field.
checked_contract.classification_composition: Sectionwise agreement plus source null measurability gives planar almost-everywhere equality with the independent raw carrier and then AlmostEverywhereHorizontallyCongruent with the canonical profile.
checked_contract.cutoff_integration: The concrete relaxed cutoff and open-range consumer derive source null measurability from IsMinimizer and consume HasTypeIVHorizontalSections without a caller-supplied planar equality or NormalizationWitness. CompatibleWithModel remains explicit.

scope_boundary: This round proves the null-measurable Fubini reconstruction and threads CMV's horizontal-slice output into the concrete cutoff. It does not prove that every source minimizer has the required sections, does not prove reduced-boundary/model compatibility, and adds no unconditional density coverage.
next_action: Define the source-side symmetrized regular type-(iv) boundary data and derive HasTypeIVHorizontalSections from interval slices plus equal-curvature circular arc continuation, keeping Lemma 3.8's excluded configurations explicit; then feed that result to the checked sectionwise cutoff consumer.
